maria_sales: Ok team — Helix Financial wants a 2-week POC. Needs streaming (SSE) with function/tool-calling, structured JSON outputs for transaction extraction, SSO (SAML), and on‑prem KMS. They're asking about pricing for reserved capacity too. Can @devon or @jamie list blockers?

devon_eng: I can take runtime questions. Main blockers: SAML SSO in a private deploy, KMS integration for on‑prem, and dataset privacy for test traffic. For streaming we support SSE/websocket and function calls. Need their network topology for handshake (IP allowlist + NAT).

sasha_devex: I have a short runbook + a minimal python snippet for streaming+func-calls. Will paste it here and link the runbook. Also we need expected qps and avg seq length to size reserved pool. @maria_sales any perf targets?

maria_sales: They want sub-200ms p95 on ~256-token responses at 100 qps sustained. Budget: exploring reserved monthly commit (approx 4x A100 equiv) or hosted with burst. Legal asked for SOC2 report + BAA.

jamie_eng_runtime: Sub-200ms p95 at 100 qps / 256 tokens is achievable with Dedicated + batching + KV prefix caching, but depends on model choice and quantization. Recommendation: start with a smaller verified model family for latency (redwood-2-mini family) for POC, then test larger for quality. I'll queue a benchmark with 100 qps profile.

lee_security: For SOC2/BAA we can provide our Type II and standard BAA templates. For KMS: need their KMS endpoint details and whether they require HSM-backed keys. For SAML: we need SP metadata and ACS/Entity IDs. Also confirm data residency requirements so legal can sign off.

sasha_devex: Snippet (minimal SSE + tool call flow):
```python
import requests, sseclient
url = 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams'
headers = {'Authorization': 'Bearer <TOKEN>', 'Accept': 'text/event-stream'}
payload = {
  'model': 'redwood-2-mini',
  'stream': True,
  'tooling': {'invoke': ['transaction_extractor']},
  'output_schema': { 'type':'object','properties':{'tx_id':{'type':'string'},'amount':{'type':'number'}}} 
}
resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, stream=True)
for event in sseclient.SSEClient(resp):
    print(event.data)
```
Note: the POC should use ephemeral creds and IP allowlist. We'll attach the runbook link after this thread.

maria_sales: Can we get a rough cost estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted for this load? And how long to spin up Private VPC + SAML?

jamie_eng_runtime: Rough estimates: hosted for this sustained workload (100 qps, 256 tokens) ~ $20k-30k/month depending on model and token mix. Dedicated reserved (4x A100 class commit + infra) ballpark ~$55k-75k/month. Private VPC with SAML/KMS provisioning typically 6-8 weeks end-to-end (includes security reviews). Dedicated reserved can be provisioned in ~2-3 weeks after contract.

devon_eng: Also note we should validate model quality vs extraction schema early — structured output regressions are common. We'll add evals for the prompt set.

maria_sales: Action items: @jamie run perf bench and share results by Fri EOD, @sasha post runbook + python snippet link, @lee start SOC2/BAA pack and SAML checklist, I'll set a call with Helix for Tue 10am PST.
